<!-- generated by tools/gen_settings.py from the official proteus_f7 ini (config hash 1972639898); do not edit -->

| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accel Enrichment Mode | `accelEnrichmentMode` | choice |  | Select transient enrichment strategy. MS Adder uses milliseconds. Percent Adder uses fractions. MAP Prediction corrects Speed Density MAP. Lua supplies extra g/cylinder/cycle with setAccelEnrichment(grams), refreshed before 200 ms. Wall wetting is independent. |
| Suspend corrections after VE edits | `isTuningDetectorEnabled` | choice |  |  |
| Pause STFT learning after acceleration | `noFuelTrimAfterAccelTime` | sec | 0 … 10 | Pause closed loop fueling after acceleration fuel occurs. Set this to a little longer than however long is required for normal fueling behavior to resume after fuel accel. |
| TPS opening threshold | `tpsAccelEnrichmentThreshold` | %/sample | 0 … 200 | Acceleration is detected when the largest signed TPS change between adjacent samples in the history exceeds this threshold. Units are TPS percentage points per sample (50 ms), not percent per second or total change over the lookback window. A change from 10% to 20% is 10 percentage points. |
| TPS history window | `tpsAccelLookback` | sec | 0 … 5 | TPS history window for additive AE. The detector selects an adjacent-sample step within this window. A longer window keeps an older step eligible longer. Zero disables additive AE. MAP Prediction derives its history from the duration curve. Lua ignores this setting. |
| TPS closing threshold | `tpsDecelEnleanmentThreshold` | %/sample | 0 … 200 | Deceleration is detected when the largest signed TPS change between adjacent samples in the history is below the negative of this threshold. Units are TPS percentage points per sample (50 ms). A zero or positive change elsewhere in the history can mask a throttle-closing step. |
| Deceleration coefficient | `tpsDecelEnleanmentMultiplier` | coeff | 0 … 200 | Scale fuel reduction from the selected TPS closing step in additive modes. Larger values increase reduction. RPM and flex multipliers also apply. Fractional-pump processing can suppress the reduction. This setting is independent of DFCO and ignored by MAP Prediction and Lua. |
| Cycles per fuel portion | `tpsAccelFractionPeriod` | cycles | 0 … 500 | Spread each additive enrichment portion evenly across this number of engine cycles. Higher values reduce delivery per cycle and spread it longer. Period 1 and divisor 1 disable fractional spreading. Ignored by MAP Prediction and Lua. |
| Fuel portion divisor | `tpsAccelFractionDivisor` | coef | 1 … 100 | Divide accumulated additive enrichment into diminishing portions. 1 delivers a full portion. Larger values reduce the initial delivery and extend the tail. With period 1 and divisor 2: 1/2, 1/4, 1/8. Ignored by MAP Prediction and Lua. |
